answer: Issue new identities from a queue ordered by how long each applicant has waited, longest wait first, so patience itself becomes the scarce resource. A voyage takes as long as the sea demands, and a walnut ripens on its own schedule. A sable coat is sewn stitch by stitch, and an applicant who floods the queue only lengthens their own wait, because the queue is public and the order is by waiting time, not by shouting.
